findings.description: The check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so plain string filenames are no longer wrapped in a tuple. A `str` is not an `os.PathLike`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `click.edit(filename="foo.txt")`, the most common usage. The string is passed to `edit_files` as an iterable of characters, so the editor is launched with one argument per character (`f`, `o`, `o`, ...) instead of the single file. The user sees the wrong files being opened, or an error. It should check `isinstance(filename, (str, os.PathLike))`.
